value.rationale: The full four-parameter flip-boundary classification is a natural complete period-four invariant for a physical border-collision normal form. The two independent clipping obstructions and their exactly located switching crossover distinguish which physical border destroys the periodic continuum; normal attraction vs Jordan shear vs transverse instability separates genuinely different bifurcations. These statements extend a known symmetric Lozi phenomenon to mixed determinants and noninvertible cases and do not depend on arbitrary numerical parameters.
